known_edge_cases: a short, bold name/title banner repeated on every page (a real, common resume pattern) -- structurally header-like on page 2 as well as page 1

RESOLVED (2026-10-19): the page-2 repeat used to occur AFTER a real section (Experience) had already started, so it didn't fold into the leading contact bucket -- it became its own spurious 'unknown' section and fragmented the true Experience continuation (the second job entry was lost under the spurious section instead of appending to 'experience'). Fixed via the first candidate direction named below: `_running_header_texts` in sections.py detects a short line whose exact normalized text appears among the first 2 lines on 2+ different pages, and `_build_sections` drops every occurrence AFTER the first (the genuine page-1 name/contact banner is untouched). Both job entries, including the second ('Beta Inc, Software Engineer'), now parse correctly into 'experience'.
notes: Milestone 2 fixture (2026-08). Originally deliberately NOT patched, per this project's established validation discipline (surface findings, don't silently fix them) -- arguably the most consequential Milestone 2 finding, a genuine reading-order/section-assignment defect for a common real-world pattern. Two candidate fix directions were named for a future pass: (1) detect text repeated verbatim near the same position across multiple pages and exclude it from header candidacy; (2) bias against re-opening a new section immediately following a very short, isolated line with no body content of its own. Direction (1) was implemented (2026-10-19) -- see known_edge_cases above. expected_sections.json now asserts the CORRECTED behavior.
